about: The numbers of the game. The app reads this file, the backend is seeded from it and the tests replay model/spawn_cases.json against it, so a rule is changed here and nowhere else. A drain rests for a player who already reported it on the same local day. Otherwise it is rare while a storm window is open, when it was never reported, or when its last report by anyone is at least 14 days old, uncommon from 3 days on, and common below that. Ages are elapsed time, days are calendar days in the timezone.
